create_cifar10_dataset: create a Cifar10 dataset instance with a data path and train or test split
load_cifar10_batch: load a single CIFAR-10 pickle batch file and return its data and labels
load_cifar10_data: load all CIFAR-10 data batches for the train or test split into memory
transform_cifar10_image: transform a CIFAR-10 image with color normalization, horizontal flip, and random crop
get_cifar10_item: get a transformed image and its label from the CIFAR-10 dataset by index
